entries.name: God of War III Remastered high frame rate
entries.description: Raises the engine frame rate cap from 59.94 to 240 FPS and keeps swing energy at its 60 Hz value
entries.notes: Frame rates are unlocked by default. For playable QTEs and the Realm of Hades wall seam above 60 FPS, also preload CUSA01715-high-fps.c built as a library (build line at its top)
